faqItems.question: What are PALMONAS REWARDS?
paragraphs: PALMONAS REWARDS are points that are accumulated in the PALMONAS wallet by the customer through various different avenues as mentioned in point 2 below.

faqItems.question: What are the different avenues to earn PALMONAS REWARDS.
paragraphs: When you register on PALMONAS you get PALMONAS REWARDS in your Wallet
Refunds on any return of products purchased in offer
Refund of orders purchased using PALMONAS REWARDS
Refund of any other value upon the discretion of the company
For clearance of doubt, Palmonas rewards and points are referred as same.

faqItems.question: What part of the order Value can the customer pay using PALMONAS REWARDS?
paragraphs: These PALMONAS REWARDS shall be applicable on all orders worth Rs 1 and above , which can be used to pay up to 99% of the order value at a time.

faqItems.question: Can I pay part of my order using PALMONAS REWARDS?
paragraphs: Yes, you can pay for order using PALMONAS REWARDS.

faqItems.question: What happens when the user Cancels or Returns?
paragraphs: When the user cancels or returns the product, the PALMONAS REWARDS get re-credited to the user’s Wallet in active or expired state depending on the original expiry duration of the PALMONAS REWARDS while they were credited to the user’s account.

faqItems.question: Where can I view PALMONAS REWARDS Wallet details?
paragraphs: You can view your PALMONAS Wallet under the My Accounts section.

faqItems.question: I have a question regarding Wallet, whom do I reach out to?
paragraphs: You can always reach out to our customer care at www.palmonas.com if you have any questions regarding PALMONAS REWARDS.

bodyLines: ELIGIBILITY:
This Offer is open to all individual legal residents of the Republic of India aged 18 or above on the Offer Start Date.
Each PALMONAS Customer should have a valid phone number and e-mail address.
Participation in this Offer is purely voluntary.
OFFER:

Customers can use 100% of the PALMONAS REWARDS that are made active up to a period of 30 days (as per the distributing program’s PALMONAS REWARDS policy.) At the end of the expiry period, the PALMONAS REWARDS become inactive and can no longer be used.
These PALMONAS REWARDS shall be applicable on all orders worth Rs. 1 and above, which can be used to pay up to 99% of the order value at a time.
